The 20 leading scorers by points per game among players who played at least 58 games. Each hexagon is a patch of the half court. Size is how often the player shot from it (full size at 50 or more attempts). Color is his field-goal percentage there minus the whole league's from the same patch: orange is better than the league, blue is worse. Hover a hexagon for its numbers.

Percentage points above or below the league: -15-10-5+0+5+10+15
